presets.label: Push in
presets.summary: The camera moves straight toward the subject over the shot: tension, or a thought landing.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Pull out
presets.summary: The camera backs away and the world opens up around the subject: isolation, an ending.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Orbit
presets.summary: A 60-degree arc round the subject at the same height and distance.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Crane up
presets.summary: The camera rises 2.5 m on a jib and tilts down to keep the subject in frame.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Crane down
presets.summary: Starts high above the set and comes down to the subject's eye line.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Dolly zoom
presets.summary: Vertigo: dolly in while the lens widens, so the subject holds its size and the background stretches.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Whip pan
presets.summary: Holds, then whips 75 degrees sideways in a quarter of a second, and settles.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Handheld follow
presets.summary: On the shoulder, riding with the subject: a handheld rig that follows a person as they move.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Drone reveal
presets.summary: Rises 8 m and pulls back over the subject to reveal the whole set.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Tracking side
presets.summary: A side-on track that moves 4 m parallel to the subject, on a dolly.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Car mount
presets.summary: The camera rides on the car's hood looking back through the windscreen at the front seats.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Bumper cam
presets.summary: Racing cinema: hard-mounted on the front bumper 35 cm off the road on an 18 mm, the road streaking past under the lens and its vibration left in, like a racing film's nose cam. It rides the car, so it spins with a J-turn; the prompts leave the car words out (its wheels are behind the lens).
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Over the tyre
presets.summary: Racing cinema: hard-mounted just above and outside the front wheel, 80 cm up on a 14 mm, looking back along the car at the rear tyre, so spray (or tyre smoke on a dry road) reads at the contact patch. Clear of the bodywork and the steered tyre. Best for spins and slides.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Arm car tracking
presets.summary: Racing cinema: a camera car paces the car 5 m off its side, lens 80 cm up on a 28 mm (a U-Crane or Russian arm), keyed along the car's whole path; it holds its side and never spins with the car. On a street it moves to the side with room, or pulls in to the kerb, and says so.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Long-lens pan
presets.summary: Racing cinema: locked off 32 m from the car's path, lens 1.2 m up on a 135 mm, panning to hold the whole car: compression and the whole J-turn in one frame. Real ones sit much further back; here the base pulls in (the lens shortening with it) to keep the car inside the stage's 40 m depth guide, and moves off a building's side of the path. The toast says what it gave up.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Camera moves

presets.label: Golden hour
presets.summary: Low warm sun just above the horizon, a glowing rim on the subject and long shadows.

presets.label: Blue hour
presets.summary: The deep blue minutes after sunset: soft cool light, the first practicals coming on.

presets.label: Night street
presets.summary: Moonlight backlight and sodium streetlights, wet blacks and pools of light.

presets.label: Noir hard key
presets.summary: One hard key, deep shadows and a venetian-blind pattern: low-key film noir.

presets.label: Neon
presets.summary: Magenta and cyan neon with a sodium practical: mixed-colour night.

presets.label: Overcast
presets.summary: A sky like a giant softbox: shadowless daylight, quiet colour.

presets.label: Candle / firelight
presets.summary: Flickering warm firelight on faces and darkness all round.

presets.label: Studio three-point
presets.summary: Key, fill and rim around the subject: clean, classic studio light. Keeps the time of day.

presets.label: J-turn
presets.summary: The car races backwards, flicks round 180 degrees and drives off nose first.

presets.label: Donut
presets.summary: Drives in, spins two tight donuts in a cloud of tyre smoke, drives out.

presets.label: Handbrake 180
presets.summary: Charges in, yanks the handbrake, slides round 180 degrees and roars back.

presets.label: Crate crash
presets.summary: Stacks six crates in the car's path, drives straight through and simulates the crash (physics, baked to keys).

presets.label: Impact shake
presets.summary: The camera jolts a beat after every baked hit (harder hits and closer ones shake more) and settles.

presets.label: Drop
presets.summary: Lifts the selected prop (or a new crate) 2.5 m and lets it fall and bounce (physics).

presets.label: Throw
presets.summary: A person throws the selected prop (or a crate) forward; physics takes it from the release.

presets.label: Car explosion
presets.summary: A pyro mortar under the car fires on its cue: fireball, shockwave and debris, the car is thrown over and burns (SFX rig, baked).

presets.label: Building blast
presets.summary: Charges at the foot of a breakaway wall: the blocks blow out in a fireball and a rolling dust cloud, the crates in front are thrown.

presets.label: Sparks shower
presets.summary: A gerb rigged overhead pours a fall of hot sparks for three seconds; they bounce off the floor and light the set orange.

presets.label: Squib hit
presets.summary: Bullet-hit squibs walk across the ground to the performer, then a body squib on the chest: a puff of fabric and stage blood, the jolt, the fall.

presets.label: Tarp in the wind
presets.summary: A tarp tied between two posts flaps and billows in gusty wind (cloth soft body, baked to a vertex cache).

presets.label: Rope bridge
presets.summary: An 8 m rope bridge between four posts: the deck sags and sways (cloth and rope soft bodies).

presets.label: Cardboard box crush
presets.summary: A cardboard box in the car's path (or under a falling crate) buckles, creases and stays crushed.

presets.label: Sand pile
presets.summary: A steep sand pile slumps and spills; in a car's path it gets ploughed through (grains soft body).

presets.label: Speedboat run
presets.summary: A speedboat on the lake: full throttle from rest, the bow climbs over the hump and levels as it planes, then a carving turn (boat physics, baked).

presets.label: Sailing tack
presets.summary: A dinghy beating to windward tacks through the wind: it slows, the boom swings across, the sailor moves over and it heels away on the new tack.

presets.label: Canoe on a calm lake
presets.summary: Two paddlers in a canoe glide across a calm lake, stroking in time; each stroke surges the hull and the stern paddler's J-stroke holds the line.

presets.label: Whitewater raft
presets.summary: Six paddlers run class III rapids: the current carries the raft through standing waves, they dig in and ferry across behind the rocks.

presets.label: Climb / mount
presets.summary: The selected person gets on the horse, into the car or onto a low prop a second into the shot.

presets.label: Diver swim
presets.summary: The person swims in scuba kit over the reef: real flutter kicks with bending fins, level trim, the regulator in the mouth and a burst of bubbles every few seconds.

presets.label: Trailer cut
presets.summary: Short, punchy clips (about 1.2 s), dips to black between beats, a fade out at the end.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Edit styles

presets.label: Music video
presets.summary: Fast cuts (about 1 s) snapped to the music's beat, white flashes on every fourth edit.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Edit styles

presets.label: Dialogue coverage
presets.summary: A first assembly from the lined script: the wide for action, the speaker's single for each line, straight cuts.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Edit styles

presets.label: Social 9:16
presets.summary: A vertical 9:16 cut with burnt-in subtitles, 1.5 s pacing and a social loudness master.
presets.where: ③ Set › Presets window (V) › Edit styles

presets.label: Video → 3D → new angle
presets.summary: Rebuild your video as a 3D set, then add a new camera setup that orbits round to a fresh angle.

presets.label: Ripple edit wardrobe
presets.summary: Opens Motion › Follow › Ripple edit and Paint Studio's Whole frame with a wardrobe prompt ready.

presets.label: Draft all shots
presets.summary: Queues a Draft of every shot in the scene (asks before it uses the GPU).

presets.label: Hollywood final
presets.summary: Sets ⑤ Motion to Hollywood quality and queues the final of the current shot (asks before it uses the GPU).

ltx_presets.name: Draft
ltx_presets.tip: A quick look: 8 + 3 steps, 1080p class. Faces readable, motion approximate.

ltx_presets.name: Final
ltx_presets.tip: Clean motion and detail: 12 + 6 steps, 1080p class, high-bitrate H.264. The default.

ltx_presets.name: Hollywood
ltx_presets.tip: The best this GPU does: 1408p (stage 1 at 704p, x2), 12 + 6 steps, near-lossless master. About 15 min a shot.

adherence.tip: More invention: a softened clay guide and a lighter Layout IC-LoRA. Natural motion, but positions and framing can drift (the old default).
Close to the clay with a little freedom for gait and limbs.
As close to the clay as LTX goes: a sharp clay guide, the full Layout IC-LoRA, and your frame as a lighter look reference so it can't pull the shot off its marks.

engines: LTX-2.5 Layout-to-Render (local, follows your clay; recommended)

controls.label: Clay guide blur (px)

controls.label: Frame reference
controls.help: How strongly your chosen frame steers the look. 1 also pulls the composition toward the frame (the opening can start off its marks); lower lets the clay win. Below 0.4 the render turns clay-grey. Empty = from Adherence (Exact 0.5).

controls.label: H.264 CRF
controls.help: Lower = better and bigger. 14 is visually lossless for these renders; 18 was the old default.
